title: One variable spectrum fits 34 bins of the 2023 ASASSN-14ko X-ray ingress with free brightness
abstract: We test whether the resolved 2023 ASASSN-14ko X-ray ingress needs a change in spectral shape. We fit a line to four-band EPIC-pn rates with free brightness in every 2-ks bin and an unknown constant spectrum. The 34 ingress bins give chi-square 94.61 for 96 degrees of freedom; a conditional Gaussian simulation gives p = 0.520. Adding the last pre-dip visit gives p = 0.0030. One pre-dip bin drives this result; its removal gives p = 0.247 for the full set. The exclusion was selected after inspection. A separate simulation shows a small downward bias in a prior weighted ratio estimator; all three observed ratios fall within its conditional 95 percent simulation intervals. The ingress remains consistent with one variable spectrum without an exponential decline or a prescribed floor. This null result does not distinguish intrinsic fading from opaque covering, identify a pericentre time, or prove an orbital period stall. We supply code, input hashes, simulation results and a retrieval program. The tests use reported pipeline rate errors and one resolved ingress.
